'Deal 2 arcane damage to target hero. / **Surge** - If this deals more than 2 damage, you may return an aura with Sigil in its name from your graveyard to your hand.' Wizard Action (batch set label OscilioBlitzDeck - pick the json/<set>/ folder from setIdentifiers at adoption). Yellow printing: amount 2 and threshold 'more than 2' (red is 3/more-than-3; blue differs likewise).

CLAUSE 1 IMPLEMENTED: PLAY + DEAL_ARCANE amount 2, target TARGET_HERO. The handler (effect_types.py:1188-1219) resolves the player via _damage_target_player (:907-931), whose shared vocabulary maps HERO/TARGET_HERO/OPPONENT identically to the opposing hero - its own docstring records that 'target hero' in practice means the other player; self-targeting is not expressible and no corpus card models it. Amount resolves through _resolve_amount and the damage goes through the canonical pipeline (effect_deal_arcane -> effect_keywords.deal_damage), so amp counters (CR 8.5.47 - the only way this card's base 2 exceeds the threshold), prevention and replacement effects all see it.

SURGE CLAUSE NOT AUTHORED - INEXPRESSIBLE TODAY, deliberately left off rather than authored dead, copying .drafts/etchings_of_arcana_red.json (same card, other printing) which follows .drafts/destructive_aethertide_blue.json (same mechanic family: Surge rider on a wizard arcane spell; its .draft-review verified that census against source). Every route fails, re-verified against source this session:
(1) The SURGE condition exists (condition_types.py:748-753) but calls surge_check(e, amount), which reads event.data['damage'] (ability_keywords.py:715-718). As a gate inside the PLAY ability it evaluates under the play-resolution event, which carries no damage payload, so it is false in EVERY state - the recorded defect on shipped dyn/swell_tidings_red (.review: 'gate-false-in-every-state').
(2) A TRIGGERED ON_DEAL_DAMAGE payoff cannot hear the damage either: _dsl_deal_damage_listener registers on the combat 'damage_dealt' event and returns immediately unless state.combat.attack_card exists (engine.py:1742-1754). This card's arcane damage flows through effect_keywords.deal_damage's generic 'damage' event, which has NO DSL listener at all (registration census engine.py:1774-1799). This is also why the triage list's ON_DEAL_DAMAGE primitive is dead here.
(3) No condition compares a damage MAGNITUDE to a threshold: LAST_DAMAGE_DEALT (reads state._last_damage_dealt, set post-prevention at effect_keywords.py:527) and DAMAGE_DEALT_THIS_TURN are amount EXPRESSIONS only (effect_types.py:76-77); grep of condition_types.py finds no condition reading either. EVENT_THIS_TURN {event: damage, qualifier: arcane} records OCCURRENCES, not magnitude - it cannot say 'more than 2', and gating on it would fire the rider on every resolved hit including base 2 damage, strictly stronger than printed.
The fix is ENGINE-side - bridge the generic 'damage' event to DSL dispatch, or add a magnitude condition - not a JSON re-author.

READY TO AUTHOR THE MOMENT THAT LANDS (zero JSON restructuring needed): the payoff is a single SEARCH_GRAVEYARD with filter_types ['Aura'] + name_contains 'Sigil' - the handler (effect_types.py:1835-1892) matches types OR subtypes for filter_types, does a case-insensitive name substring for name_contains, defaults destination hand, and is already optional via ask_optional/FAIL_TO_FIND ('you may ... or fail to find'), which also satisfies release note 1 (the Sigil is chosen at resolution, after the damage). It is omitted from this file only because attaching it to a gate that can never fire would look implemented while doing nothing.

PRINTED Surge KEYWORD IS INERT engine-side (triggers/triggers.py:400-401 - the surge branch is 'pass # Card-specific'), so nothing double-fires today and nothing is lost by omitting the clause.
